land.text: Sitawaka, part of the Kotte kingdom divided in 1521

predecessors.note: The three sons of Vijayabahu VII divided Kotte into Kotte, Sitawaka and Raigama.

successors.note: The Sitawaka lowlands went back to Kotte after 1594 ('re-annexed'); the interior went to Kandy. [Repair 2026-10-20: the Ratnapura circle dropped: the interior went to Kandy in 1593 (ledger).]

capitals.name: Sitawaka (Avissawella)
capitals.note: 'The capital city (modern Avissawella) was situated on a steep hill'. Coordinates approximate.

rulers.name: Mayadunne
rulers.note: The end is read from Rajasinha I's infobox reign (1581-1593); the page has no reign dates for Mayadunne.

rulers.name: Rajasinha I (Tikiri Banda)
rulers.note: The infobox gives 1581-1593 for the reign and 1594 for his death; the introduction has his death in 1593. The Rajasinha I of Sitawaka page gives the reign as 1581-1592 and his death in March 1592.

correction.text: a relatively small area round Sitawaka (Avissawella): Hanwella, Padukka, Kuruwita and Ratnapura

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria's Ceylon, 1352-1506, and Portuguese Ceylon, 1507-1686, are one-island rows). The page: Sitawaka 'emerged from the division of the Kingdom of Kotte following the Spoiling of Vijayabahu in 1521'; the starting area was 'a relatively small area' with 'places such as Hanwella, Padukka, Kuruwita and Ratnapura'. No area; the shape is a 25 km circle at Avissawella (80.21 E, 6.95 N, approximate) and a 25 km circle at Ratnapura, my reading. [Repair 2026-10-20: the Avissawella circle was 40 km, which took in Kotte (79.92 E, 6.89 N, about 33 km away) and Colombo from 1521 and left kingdom-of-kotte one H3 cell; the page's initial area ('Kosgama, Ruwanwella, Yatiyanthota', Hanwella, Padukka, Ehaliyagoda, Kuruwita, Rathnapura) lies within about 25 km of Avissawella or round Ratnapura. The Mayadunne of Sitawaka page, opened for the extent, says the kingdom started 'controlling roughly the modern day Sabaragamuwa Province ( Kegalle, Ratnapura Districts)' with its seat at Avissawella: the two pages agree on the Kegalle-Ratnapura country and the circles are kept as the smaller reading.]

correction.text: the Sitawaka core with Raigama (the Kalutara area), annexed in 1538

keyframe_review.note: 'Mayadunne annexed Raigama in 1538, following the death of Raigam Bandara (Pararajasinha) in 1538'. The page does not say where Raigama lay; the Kalutara district is my reading (the Kotte page's 'Principality of Raigama' gives no place either).

correction.text: the core, Raigama and the Kotte lowlands (Colombo and Gampaha districts) without Colombo city

keyframe_review.note: 'By 1564 Sitawaka controlled much of the kingdom [of Kotte], with garrisons at Wattala, Nagalagama and Mapane'; those garrisons 'were expelled in 1574'. The Kotte page: 'Most of the areas of Kotte Kingdom were annexed to the Kingdom of Sitawaka' (no year); in 1565 Dharmapala left Kotte for Colombo under Portuguese protection. The garrisons are not drawn separately; Colombo (25 km) is left out as Dharmapala's refuge. [Repair 2026-10-20: with the 25 km circle the shape grows from about 4,550 km2 (1538-1563) to about 5,060 km2 (1564): the Colombo and Gampaha districts together are only about 2,300 km2 (nine H3 cells), the 25 km Avissawella circle already holds part of Colombo district and the 25 km Colombo circle is left out, so the 1564 gain is about 500 km2 (before the fix both shapes were about 6,000 km2 and the gain was nil). The grid cannot show more; the page gives 'much of the kingdom' and no area.]

correction.text: the whole island except the Jaffna kingdom and the Portuguese holdings (Colombo, Galle)

keyframe_review.note: 'In 1582, the new king invaded and conquered the kingdom of Kandy'; after that Sitawaka held 'the entirety of Sri Lanka ... with the exception of the Jaffna kingdom and Portuguese holdings in the south' (the page's words as relayed; it does not list the holdings). The Kandy page dates the conquest to 1581, which opens the keyframe. Jaffna is drawn as the Yapanaya, Kilinochchi, Mannarama, Mulativ and Vavuniya districts; the Portuguese holdings as Colombo (25 km) and Galle (20 km), my reading.

correction.text: the lowland core round Sitawaka (Avissawella), Raigama and the Kotte lowlands after Kandy's independence in 1593: the Ratnapura country has gone to Kandy

keyframe_review.note: Vimaladharmasuriya 'defeated Rajasinha I in 1593 at Balane and Mawela, effectively securing Kandy's independence from Sitawaka'; 'within less than a year Sitawaka had ceased to function as a cohesive polity'; the page does not say who held the south and east. The shape repeats the 1564-1580 lowlands; the choice is mine. [Repair 2026-10-20: the Ratnapura circle is out of this shape because the ledger of 1593 gives the Ratnapura, Kegalle and Kurunegala districts to Kandy (it overlapped kingdom-of-kandy by about 2,000 km2 in 1593).]

correction.text: Avissawella, a Kandyan border town, in the year the Portuguese sacked it

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: 'In 1594 the Portuguese forces sacked the city and pressed inland'; 'Avissawella was reduced to being a border town' of resurgent Kandy; the Kotte lowlands are re-annexed to Kotte in 1594 (Kotte page), so Sitawaka's shape this year is the core alone. [Repair 2026-10-20: new keyframe; the 1593-1594 shape overlapped kingdom-of-kotte by about 1,800 km2 in 1594.]

region.text: Sitawaka: Hanwella, Padukka, Kuruwita and Ratnapura

ledger.note: 1521: Sitawaka 'emerged from the division of the Kingdom of Kotte following the Spoiling of Vijayabahu in 1521'; Vijayabahu VII 'was deposed in a palace coup', 'Mayadunne ruling from Sitawaka and Pararajasinha establishing the kingdom of Raigama'. The Kotte page: the three sons 'killed their father, dividing the kingdom among themselves'.
1538: Raigama joins Sitawaka. 'Mayadunne annexed Raigama in 1538, following the death of Raigam Bandara (Pararajasinha) in 1538.' The place is not on the page; the Kalutara district is my reading.

By 1564: Sitawaka holds 'much of the kingdom' of Kotte, with garrisons at Wattala, Nagalagama and Mapane. The Sitawaka page gives no date for the first acquisition (the year is a 'by'); the Kotte page: 'Most of the areas of Kotte Kingdom were annexed to the Kingdom of Sitawaka' (no year) and 'In 1565, the capital of Kotte was abandoned' by Dharmapala 'because of attacks from' Sitawaka.

region.text: the garrisons at Wattala, Nagalagama and Mapane

ledger.note: 1574: the garrisons at Wattala, Nagalagama and Mapane 'were expelled'. The page calls 1574 a Portuguese attack ('Negombo, Kalutara and Beruwala were plundered'); the garrisons were small posts and the shape is not changed. Wattala is not in the gazetteer.

1581: Kandy is annexed. Kandy page: 'invaded twice during the 1570s and 1580s, first in 1574 and again in 1581', 'succeeded in annexing Kandy outright', infobox 'Conquest by Sitawaka: 1581'. The Sitawaka page: 'In 1582, the new king invaded and conquered the kingdom of Kandy to the east.'

region.text: the rest of the island except the Jaffna kingdom and the Portuguese holdings

ledger.note: 1582: the rest of the island. Having conquered Kandy, Sitawaka held 'the entirety of Sri Lanka ... with the exception of the Jaffna kingdom and Portuguese holdings in the south'. The page does not say what 'the entirety' took in or when; the region is the island short of Jaffna, Colombo and Galle and of land already counted; the counterpart is 'nobody' because no state is named.

region.text: the Kandyan uplands and the provinces round them

ledger.note: 1593: Kandy breaks away. Vimaladharmasuriya 'defeated Rajasinha I in 1593 at Balane and Mawela, effectively securing Kandy's independence from Sitawaka'. The Kandy page puts the ascension of Vimaladharmasuriya I in 1592 and gives him Uva, Sabaragamuwa and the Seven Korales ('~1592') and the Four Korales ('~1594').

region.text: the southern and eastern lands of the 1581-1592 shape

ledger.note: 1593 (bridging): the rest of the island outside the lowlands. 'Within less than a year Sitawaka had ceased to function as a cohesive polity'; the page does not say who held the south and the east afterwards. Page silent. [Repair 2026-10-20: the Rajasinha I of Sitawaka page, opened for this, has nothing on the south and east after 1593 (it dates his death to March 1592 'on his return from the defeat at Balana', gives the reign as 1581-1592, and mentions a rebellion of Konappu Bandara in Kandy and one of Pothupala Bandara in the Sath Korale, 'with Portuguese support', suppressed); the extent after 1593 stays page-silent, confidence 1.]

1594: the Kotte lands return. The Kotte page: 'After Sitawaka fell in 1594', 'these areas were re-annexed to the Kotte kingdom'. The Sitawaka page: 'In 1594 the Portuguese forces sacked the city'. The extent is my reading (the lowlands without the core).

region.text: Sitawaka (Avissawella), left a Kandyan border town

ledger.note: 1594: Sitawaka ends. Infobox 'Death of Rajasinha I: 1594'; the introduction has 1593; 'In 1594 the Portuguese forces sacked the city and pressed inland' until Kandyan forces expelled them; 'Avissawella was reduced to being a border town' of resurgent Kandy.

wars.name: Sitawaka-Kotte-Portuguese wars
wars.outcome: Attempt on Kotte in 1537 failed; invasions of 1539 and 1543 repelled; Portuguese sack of Sitawaka in 1550 not held; Portuguese 'decisively routed' at Mulleriyawa in 1562; 1564 attack on Kotte; 1565 Dharmapala leaves Kotte for Colombo.

wars.name: Sitawaka conquest of Kandy
wars.outcome: Invaded in 1574 and 1581, annexed outright (1581 on the Kandy page, 1582 on the Sitawaka page).

wars.name: Siege of Colombo
wars.outcome: 'A twenty-two month siege of Colombo' from 1587 with some 50,000 infantry; Rajasinha I 'was forced to abandon the siege in February 1588'.

wars.name: Kandyan war of independence from Sitawaka

zones.text: Kandy and the provinces round it

wars.outcome: Vimaladharmasuriya beat Rajasinha I at Balane and Mawela in 1593; the Portuguese sacked Sitawaka in 1594 and were expelled by Kandy.

certainty.note: The page gives no boundary; circles round Avissawella and Ratnapura, and the Kalutara district.
'Much of the kingdom' (1564) and 'the entirety of Sri Lanka' except Jaffna and Portuguese holdings (1582): the page names no frontier.
The page does not say who held what after Balane and Mawela.

sources.title: Kingdom of Sitawaka
sources.note: Opened twice: founding 1521, Raigama 1538, the 1560s wars, Kandy 1582, Colombo siege 1587-88, the end 1593/94.

sources.title: Kingdom of Kandy
sources.note: Infobox 'Conquest by Sitawaka: 1581' and 'Ascension of Vimaladharmasuriya I: 1592'; the Sitawaka rulers in Kandy 1582-1592.

sources.title: Kingdom of Kotte
sources.note: 'Most of the areas of Kotte Kingdom were annexed to the Kingdom of Sitawaka'; re-annexed to Kotte 'after Sitawaka fell in 1594'.

sources.title: Mayadunne of Sitawaka
sources.note: Opened for the extent before 1564: 'controlling roughly the modern day Sabaragamuwa Province (Kegalle, Ratnapura Districts)'; Raigama annexed in 1538; 'more and more of the lands of Kotte became part of Sitawaka' (no date).

sources.title: Rajasinha I of Sitawaka
sources.note: Opened for the end of Sitawaka: death in March 1592, reign 1581-1592; no account of the south and east after 1593.

notes:
No Cliopatria row. Three pages (Sitawaka twice; Kandy and Kotte as mirrors). The Sitawaka page has no area and names no frontier, and says nothing about the territory in 1587.
Disagreements: (1) Rajasinha I died in 1593 (introduction) or 1594 (infobox and 'the following year'); (2) the Kandy conquest is 1581 (Kandy page) or 1582 (Sitawaka page); (3) Kandy's independence is 1593 (Balane and Mawela, Sitawaka page) or 1592 (Vimaladharmasuriya's ascension, Kandy page); (4) the Battle of Mulleriyawa is 1562 on the page (not 1559); the page does not say Rajasinha took Kotte in 1580 (it has Dharmapala's 1580 declaration of succession).
Not settled: the extent before 1564 (circles and one district); the Raigama location (Kalutara is a guess); who held the south and east after 1593; what the Portuguese took in 1594; the 1582 'entirety' (island less Jaffna, Colombo and Galle is my reading).
Counterparts needing a dossier: principality-of-raigama (1521-1538, the third part of the Kotte division); dutch-ceylon / portuguese-ceylon are sa-06; Cliopatria's Jaffna Kingdom (to 1594) is sa-04-a.
Gazetteer names needed: Avissawella (place, capital, 80.21 E 6.95 N), Hanwella, Wattala, Nagalagama, Mapane (places).

[Repair 2026-10-20, sa-04-x-fix] Radius: the circle round Avissawella is 25 km everywhere in this dossier and in kingdom-of-kotte (it was 40 km and swallowed Kotte and Colombo). Extent before 1564: the Mayadunne page says 'roughly the modern day Sabaragamuwa Province (Kegalle, Ratnapura Districts)' against this dossier's two circles; kept as the smaller reading. After 1593: the Rajasinha I page is silent on the south and east. New disagreement: Rajasinha I died in March 1592 (his own page) against 1593 and 1594 on the Sitawaka page. Gazetteer names needed (unchanged): Avissawella, Hanwella, Wattala, Nagalagama, Mapane.
